verdict.rationale: Openness of source code is a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows that Adyen for Platforms publishes its source under an open license. The items cover APIs, webhooks, the MCP server, hosted onboarding and llms.txt, none of which is open-source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
